nom: PEACH & LILY Transparen-C Pro Spot Treatment

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily-leaning skin do not describe this product specifically, but several non-oily-skin users note the formula itself feels oily and can clog pores in hot/humid weather.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry, flaky, or extremely dry skin (including one with seborrheic dermatitis) report it as gentle, hydrating, and effective at fading dark spots without irritation.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers are split: some find it non-irritating and gentler than other vitamin C serums, while others report it is a bit too potent, mildly irritating, or usable only a few times a week.
segments.mature: Reviewers in their 50s-60s report fading of long-standing age and sun spots, though one 64-year-old reports new breakouts and disappointment with the oiliness.

concerns.aging: A few older reviewers describe lighter age spots and softened fine lines/expression lines with continued use.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers describe the product as moisturizing or hydrating, sometimes replacing a separate moisturizer in warm weather; no reports of dryness from the product itself, though one reviewer with dry skin said it dried her skin out.
concerns.redness: Only briefly mentioned: one reviewer contrasts it favorably with other vitamin C products that made her skin red, finding this one calming instead.
concerns.barrier: Not directly discussed by reviewers as a distinct concern beyond general sensitivity and irritation comments.
concerns.spots: The large majority of reviewers report visible fading of dark spots, hyperpigmentation, sun/age spots, melasma, and acne scars, often within two weeks to a few months; a minority (several 1-3 star reviews) report no change at all after months of consistent use.
concerns.blemishes: Several reviewers say it helps heal and lighten marks left by picked or popped pimples; one describes a cystic pimple healing faster, another a tiny blemish gone by noon.
concerns.oiliness: Consistently described as an oily-textured product; some reviewers with breakout-prone skin report it caused new pimples or clogged pores, while many others say it absorbed well and did not worsen oiliness or breakouts.

aspects.libelle: Oily texture but absorbs and hydrates well
Small amount lasts a long time

extraits.texte: At 30, I still regular get acne. My sensitive, fair skin also tends to hold on to hyperpigmentation after a pimple has dried up and vanished. I've tried many products to fade these spots. I used this spot treatment (kind of all over my face since there are so many dark spots) morning and night for six months. I never felt any irritation from it. It didn't noticeably or miraculously fade my dark spots, though, which has been a real shame. I would even really massage it into the spots, but it never seemed to accelerate the clearing. Honestly not sure if this product was the thing to help fade the spots, or if they just did naturally, as they slowly tend to do from my normal daily skincare routine. Time to try something else, yet again.

I really wanted to like this, but after weeks of consistent use, I realized it caused breakouts. I took a break from using, & when I started up again, I got pimples only in the areas I used this product on. I wouldn't recommend for acne prone skin.

My skin type is dry, sensitive, and acne prone. I've tried pure vitamin C and that burned my skin. Since this is an oil based derivative, I thought I'd give it a try! I tried using it as a face serum and that was a bit too intense and caused some acne. I mixed a few drops with my moisturizer every other day and my skin seems to handle that. Unfortunately my skin is a bit too sensitive so I might go for a lower percentage vitamin next time.

My Go Tooooo !!! I cant live without this product .This product has removed dark spots that i thought would never disappear. . Gentle enough for my extremely dry skin (soberrheric dermatitis). Any dark dpot gone with two weeks when applied to the area daily. One bottle lasted me a year as i only use it to treat dark spots . Ladies GET IT

This gives me such a noticeable glow and revives my skin in the morning, especially when I'm tired and haven't had enough sleep. I have recommended this to many of my friends. I've tried the Paula's Choice vitamin C before and did not like the stronger fragrance there and noticed less of a glow than I get with this one from Peach and Lily. One bottle lasts a fairly long time as well, almost a full year for me. I have sensitive skin and have never had an issue with this serum despite it being a 20% concentration.

I'm on my second bottle of the Vitamin C Spot Serum. I've seen a noticeable change in my dark spots on my face and on the back of my hands. I'm an older lady who spent too much time in the sun when I was younger. I have a few dark spots on my face & back of my hands. I use this serum twice a day and after three to four months of use, I can tell the spots are fading. I will continue to use this product. The serum is oily, but disappears into my skin and does not break my face out. I would recommend this as I have all the Peach & Lily products that I have tried so far.

This serum might be a little too heavy for humid/hot months—it clogs my pores—but I find that it works well for the rest of the seasons. I've tried other Vitamin C serums and nothing comes close to this skincare formula!! My holy grail. I've seen results in as little as 1 week. I apply this every morning, followed by moisturizer & sunscreen.
